name: Groundnut meal, oil 5-20%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of groundnut seeds (Arachis hypogaeaL.). This product has a high content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure only. Other names: groundnut cake, groundnut oil cake, peanut cake, peanut oil cake, peanut meal, peanut oil meal.

name: Methionine Hydroxy Analog MHA
description: Organic chemical compound used in animal feeding as an analogue of DL-methionine. Full name: DL-2-hydroxy-(4-methylthio) butanoic acid.

name: Maize distillers grains with solubles, ethanol production, dried
description: Byproduct of alcohol (ethanol) manufacture, obtained from the distillery of maize grains (Zea maysL.), consisting of spent grains and steepwater solubles in variable proportions. Other names and alternative spellings: dried distillers grains with solubles, maize DDGS, corn DDGS, maize distillers' grains, maize distiller's grains, corn distillers.

name: Cottonseed, whole
description: Whole seed of cotton (Gossypiumspp.). Other name: full-fat cottonseed.

name: Linseed meal, oil < 5%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of linseeds (Linum usitatissimumL.). This product has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction. Other names: flaxseed meal, flaxseed oil meal.

name: Soybean protein concentrate, protein 70-90%
description: Protein concentrate obtained from defatted and ground soybean seeds (Glycine max(L.) Merr.) by the separation of soluble fractions, ash and non-nitrogenous compounds. Soybean concentrates with particularly high protein content are sometimes called soybean isolates or soy isolates.

name: Wheat gluten
description: Byproduct of the manufacture of starch from wheat grains (Triticumspp.) by wet milling. It consists principally of gluten obtained during the separation of starch. Wheat gluten is a protein-rich product (about 80% crude protein as fed) mostly used for human food, with some applications for animal feeding.

name: Magnesium oxide
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula MgO. Other name: magnesia.

name: Buckwheat hulls
description: Hulls of buckwheat seeds (Fagopyrum esculentumL.). This is a byproduct of the processing of buckwheat for milling or other purposes.

name: Magnesium oxide, powder
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula MgO. Other name: magnesia.

name: Monosodium phosphate anhydrous FG
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula NaH2PO4. This product is of feed grade quality.

name: Molybdenum trioxide
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula MoO3.

name: Wheat distillers grains, starch > 7%, dried
description: Byproduct of alcohol (ethanol) manufacture, obtained from the distillery of wheat grains (Triticum aestivumL., also known asTriticum aestivumL. subsp.aestivum), consisting of spent grains and steepwater solubles in variable proportions. This process begins with the separation of the bran, which is reintroduced in the byproduct after starch extraction, resulting in distillers grains containing more starch (> 7% as fed) than those resulting from a process without preliminary bran separation. Other names and alternative spellings: wheat DDGS, wheat distillers' grains, wheat distiller's grains.

name: Copper methionine
description: Methionine and copper complex used as a source of organic copper. These products have a variable copper content.

name: Brewers grains, dried
description: Dried byproduct of brewery, consisting of the spent grains left after the production of beer and other malt products (malt extracts and malt vinegar). Though beer can be made with other grains, such as sorghum or rice, the values indicated below are only for brewers grains obtained from barley (Hordeum vulgareL.). Alternative spellings: brewer's grains, brewers' grains.

name: Copper oxide
description: Copper(II) oxide or cupric oxide is the inorganic compound with the formula CuO.

name: Lentils
description: Seeds of lentil (Lens esculentaMoench). Lentil is a major grain legume used around the world as human food.

name: Copper proteinate
description: Complex chemical compound where copper is chelated with short-chain peptides. These products have a variable copper content.

name: Limestone
description: Sedimentary rock, composed mainly of the minerals calcite and aragonite, which are different crystal forms of calcium carbonate (CaCO3). Limestone is used in animal feeding as a source of calcium.

name: Disodium phosphate anhydrous
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula Na2HPO4. Other name: sodium hydrogen phosphate.
